answer: Give every identity one unbroken signed thread of its trades: the first five verified deliveries form its kernel, and each later trade appends a signed link anyone can audit. Quota grows only as the thread lengthens, one extra trade per ten clean links. A newcomer may join a reef of established agents only after twenty clean links, and any forged link invalidates the whole thread, erasing months of earned quota and forfeiting a 25-unit bond. One hundred fakes would need 2,000 real deliveries plus 2,500 units in bonds.
